annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it explains paid entry into BitClub Network mining pools, cites a $500 stake and monthly BTC income, and displays a two-sided team and rank-based bonus plan. The U.S. Department of Justice describes BitClub as a fraudulent mining-share program that used false mining-earnings figures and paid for recruiting investors. This upload markets that named program rather than neutrally examining it.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 is primary for the paid mining-share return; S06 is secondary for the visible left/right teams, ranks and cycle bonuses. The video warning that profits are not guaranteed does not change the DOJ-documented identity of the promoted program.
